hooks.command: sh -c 'case "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" in 1|[Tt][Rr][Uu][Ee]) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; n() { d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ai-rulez.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null) || d=/; (cd "$d" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; "$@"); r=$?; if [ "$d" != / ]; then rmdir "$d" 2>/dev/null; fi; return $r; }; if command -v ai-rulez >/dev/null 2>&1 && ai-rulez session-start; then exit 0; fi; if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && n npx -y ai-rulez@latest session-start; then exit 0; fi; if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && n uvx --from ai-rulez@latest ai-rulez session-start; then exit 0; fi; echo "ai-rulez session-start: no ai-rulez, npx or uvx could run; skipped" >&2; exit 0'
